terms.definition: About four-fifths nitrogen and one-fifth oxygen, with small proportions of carbon dioxide, water vapour and noble gases.
Mainly carbon dioxide with little or no oxygen, released by intense volcanic activity, which also released water vapour that condensed to form the oceans.
terms.examiner: Evidence is limited because it was so long ago.

terms.definition: It dissolved in the oceans and formed carbonate precipitates (sediments); algae and plants removed it by photosynthesis.
terms.examiner: Also locked into fossil fuels and sedimentary rocks.

terms.definition: Algae and plants produced oxygen by photosynthesis.
terms.examiner: About 2.7 billion years ago algae first produced oxygen.
